notes:
I couldn't write the Psalm 98 notes because none of my research went through.

My first attempt to fetch the sources was refused straight away. The tool said I had no searches or page fetches left for this turn. The pages I tried to open were:

- Enduring Word on Psalm 98
- Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Wesley's Notes on biblehub.com
- Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* on studylight.org
- Augustine's exposition on newadvent.org (listed there as Psalm 97, because the Latin Bible numbers the Psalms differently)
- The NET Bible notes on netbible.org

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and not fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I read nothing, I don't have a single sourced point to give you. Writing the notes from memory would break those rules, so I haven't.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll fetch those pages first. Then I'll add Matthew Henry, Barnes, preceptaustin.org, the Lutheran and Orthodox sites, and searches on whether verse 9 points to Christ's return or describes God reigning now. After that I'll write the verse-by-verse notes with a URL for each point.
